answer: Under adversarial gale conditions, Sybil clusters face quadratic slashing: each appended identity multiplies collateral erosion by n², so capital lockup C(n)=kn² grows super-linearly. With extractable value v bounded, equilibrium demands kn²>v at every terrace of validator growth; any vine of forged stake is eroded faster than yields accrue, forcing marginal attack cost above returns and sustaining consensus.
